description: Implementation of the ru_dummy_impl class managing slot timing, sector coordination, and loop execution for a radio unit dummy module in a 3GPP-like system.

classes.name: ru_dummy_impl
classes.description: Class implementing dummy radio unit behavior, managing slots, sectors, and timing notifications.

methods.name: get_current_system_slot
methods.description: Calculates current system slot based on system time, slot duration, and total slots in all hyper SFNs.

methods.name: ru_dummy_impl::ru_dummy_impl
methods.description: Constructor initializing the dummy radio unit with configuration and dependencies.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the radio unit, initializes system slot, and begins sector operation and loop.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops all sectors and signals termination of the main loop.

methods.name: defer_loop
methods.description: Schedules the main loop asynchronously unless a stop is requested.

methods.name: loop
methods.description: Main execution loop managing slot timing, boundary notifications, and sector updates.
